metadata.source: ACS 5-yr 2019-2023 block-group estimates allocated to 2020 Census blocks inside Boston city (TIGERweb place 2507000; blocks selected by interior point), using 2020 PL 94-171 block counts refined with Boston building footprints (BPDA Boston_Buildings layer 9).
metadata.method: Count fields = block-group value x block share. Share = 2020 block pop (persons) or housing units (households), blended 50/50 with residential floor-area share (pooled within each block group so totals are preserved). Residential = land_use R1-R4,RC,A,CM,CD; floor area = footprint x round(height/3.5), default height 3.5 m. Medians and poverty are copied from the block group / tract, not allocated. Estimates; inherit ACS margins of error. Includes water-only blocks (land_area_m2 = 0).
